steps.text: run the totality oracles being refuted in one batched run confirmed with run --each (run --invariant <name>... --each), and see each green batched and alone
steps.leaves: run record for the bullets, pass; per-test run record, pass

steps.text: stage the smallest break that changes the behavior the bullet claims, not the strings the detector reads; read the diff to confirm the edit touched only the lines you meant
refute <component>/<name> --broke "<what you changed>"; the detector fails on its own assertion, not by a hang, a kill, a timeout, or what an earlier test left behind
steps.leaves: run record for the bullet, refutation red

steps.text: restore the source byte for byte: from HEAD when the code under test is committed, and from a copy taken before the break when it is not
steps.leaves: the file matches its state before the break (git diff against HEAD, or cmp against the copy)

steps.text: run them again in one batched run confirmed with run --each, and see each green batched and alone
steps.leaves: run record for the bullets, pass; per-test run record, pass

steps.text: when the red did not come from the break, record a decision that this refutation does not count and refute again; the run store is append-only, so the correction is a later record

pitfalls: a sed matched two lines, so the test hung and went red only when it was killed (d-828ddc83)
a substring detector passed an unconditional early return that kept every expected string (df-c40bb904, x-429ed176)
the red came from the selected test depending on what earlier tests appended, not from the break (d-c4be0b1a, df-9e673484)
a self-asserted refuted: line read as witnessed, and an automatic refutation proved the instrument reports a site, not that the classifier calls it a bypass (df-b9b2711b, df-87881a8d)
a break that turns a test red when the via does not test the claim refutes nothing; record unable instead (u-2e6ee400)

1.because: the bullet was new, so its test was seen failing before the fix and passing after it with node --test, not batched with run --each before the break

6.because: the red came from the break, on the test's own index assertion

steps.text: classify it: record the defect with --class, --introduced and --caught, or classify one already recorded (classify <defect-id>); a class declared nowhere is declared once first, as the property class <name> of defect (lexicon propose define defect)
steps.leaves: the defect's or the classification's id

steps.text: sweep the codebase for siblings of the same shape (the same comparison, call or pattern wherever else it is written) and fix each one, then record the sweep: what was searched and every sibling it found, or that it found none
steps.leaves: the sweep: what was searched and each sibling found and fixed, or none

steps.text: guard or decide: name an invariant whose enforcement covers the whole class (a chokepoint, or a totality oracle over the class whose test fails on any member), adding the bullet when none exists; or record a decision saying why fixing the instance suffices
steps.leaves: the guard's <component folder>/<invariant> or the decision's id

steps.text: refute the guard: witness a refutation of it, staging a break of the class's shape rather than replaying the instance
record the close: resolved <defect-id> --because "<what fixed it, and the sweep>" with --guard <component folder>/<invariant> or --decision <id>, then run spec --check
steps.leaves: the resolution's id; spec --check names no close with neither

pitfalls: the symbolic-link spelling was fixed where the upgrade test found it, and only a sweep of the same comparison found the second site, in practice delivery's cd routing (df-ccfd4309, 4b1890f)
a second door opened past the warm server's chokepoint reached main because nothing that ran before the merge checked chokepoints; a guard protects only where it runs (df-5961bdb2)
an ownership defect was fixed for one kernel practice when its class was every kernel practice of every release; the guard that held was the one that read them all (df-36efa8f2, 4b1890f)
